top_creatures.label: Reaction through the hit chain

top_creatures.keep: one hit path for every actor

originals.name: Marsh ripple water
originals.idea: A flat water plane with a scrolling normal map and sun glint, calmer in fight zones
originals.change: our own normal map, depth-based shore tint, our palette

originals.name: Gentle exploration bob
originals.idea: A low-amplitude head bob with a speed limiter, on while exploring and off in the fight camera
originals.keep: cosine arc, speed limiter, first-person gate
originals.change: our amplitude and period; zero in the fight camera

originals.name: On-hit handler chain
originals.idea: Ordered on-hit handlers where a false return stops the rest, all reading one attack record
originals.keep: ordered handlers with early stop; one record
originals.change: our fields and names; no Lua API

originals.name: Combat music on target-set change
originals.idea: Compute the target list each tick, emit only on change, skip the work when idle
originals.change: our cue names tied to zone data and a boss-intro stinger

originals.name: Title-only display face
originals.idea: One display face for titles and a card-style face for item names, never body text
originals.change: our own free face with its licence file kept alongside; no reserved name on a modified copy

originals.name: One post-effect file per grade
originals.idea: Each colour effect is its own named file so a zone can choose a grade

originals.name: Shield-slot redistribution
originals.idea: When a slot is empty, hits meant for it land on a neighbouring slot so armour still takes the blow
originals.change: our slot names and the neighbour choice
